rationale: The agent removed the hardcoded ±0.01 cap in reconcileTotal (the actual workaround) and replaced it with the real rounded difference via roundMoney, which correctly handles any rounding discrepancy size and any number of line items, not just the reported 2-cent case. It also made buildInvoice's total use the same currency-aware roundMoney instead of a hardcoded *100 round, improving consistency without altering the existing JPY whole-yen handling since roundMoney (already used for discountTotal/taxTotal) is untouched.
